snippet.title: A.I.L.A - Official Developer Overview Trailer | The MIX Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Join the creative director at Pulsatrix Studios for a deep dive into the gameplay and more from A.I.L.A in this latest trailer for the upcoming first-person horror game set in a near-future filled with immersive technology. In A.I.L.A, play as the sole game tester for a revolutionary new fictional AI. Survive intense horror experiences that prey on your deepest fears as the lines between virtual and reality begin to blur. A.I.L.A will be available on PC.
